notes.title: Patch 2 - New Voiceover Feature!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/22e6f8034da724e90eed164f384903cf3ec7f740.png"]

Grifford is (we believe) the first game to put the voice recording capabilities directly into the game.

Record, stop, and playback each character line as you play through the game!

Choose the characters you want to voice; from Erika and Cap to The often clueless Town Guard and the nefarious Dark Cloaks!

The resulting Audio files are saved in a folder for you to play, to edit, or to share with others.

We'd love to hear your voices for the Grifford Cast so please do feel free to share them in our Discord!


Please give us as much feedback as possible so we can improve the feature.



Other fixes and improvements:

- Modified Jinnie's Attack Guitar chord pitch, so that the guitar chords better match the background music.

- Chapter 5 minor story tweaks

- Tweaked seating heights for certain scenes.

- Fixed a bug that allow the priestesses to help out at the end.

- Fixed the issue of Locked Locations in the Sewers, if you choose to Heist by Streets instead of the sewers.

- Fixed error where - if Jinnie gets the trait: Deferential ('Defense Up' on combat start) then combat may get stuck.

notes.title: Patch 1 - Stats Update
notes.notes:
Hello all, based on your feedback during the closed beta, we've added the ability to access your Stats screen while adjusting your build. 

This means you can now clearly see how your changes impact your build in real time. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/8f777a56cf0ced517ee07398fd29efebc62c1a20.gif"]

In Grifford Academy, you can freely assign and unassign points, making it easier than ever to experiment with different builds and playstyles. 


[hr][/hr]Changelog -> 0.1.0

Major
New Character 'Stats' panel added to the Character Development Screen.
Minor
Fixing some double spacing in story script.

Improved camera positioning in Chapter 4 and Chapter 5.

Added DarkCloaks running in to stop them spawning out of thin air. For C4Ardalla.

Add a Distractor animation to loading bar.

CreditPanel prefab updated to remove duplicate Attribution section.

Updated the effect description for Evade as it didn't parse correctly.

Fixed buff value is still given to a character when a trait (personal growth) is just incremented but not awarded.

Updating main menu buttons.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue in Chapter 5 where 'Access the ...' quests were being listed in the Quest list on the map. They now have their own icon, and are not included in the quest list.

Fixed error triggered from InputSystem due to null device layout name. This is caused by empty devices in PlayerInput when current active gamepad is being disconnected in wired mode.

notes.title: Release Date + Updated Demo
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're got some big news to share—Grifford Academy will officially be launching into Early Access on July 8th! We're incredibly excited to finally announce the date and can't wait for you all to experience this wonderful story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/2378f2b1f60d3cd1c23f820e9a7e0c6312baacf4.png
 
But that's not all...
 
We're just pushed a fresh update to the Chapter 1 demo! This update includes a number of improvements based on your feedback, as well an updated intro sequence that adds more story context and better sets the stage for the journey ahead. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/396ee4f404dd2ce841c398a22e1419296743e248.png 

Whether you're new to Grifford Academy or returning to see what's changed, we'd love for you to jump in and check it out!
